fields.name: The Glass Pavilion
fields.description: A bright, architectural setting for ceremonies, private dinners, and celebrations framed by white sand and blue water.

fields.name: Sunset Terrace
fields.description: An easygoing waterfront terrace for sunset receptions, long-table dining, and evenings that flow into the night.

fields.name: Oceanfront Villa
fields.description: A private escape for intimate celebrations, weekend gatherings, and hosted experiences with a view in every direction.

fields.name: Barefoot Gathering
fields.features:
Seaside setup for up to 150 guests
Tables, chairs and relaxed beachside seating
Team on site to welcome guests, set up and clear away afterwards
Event coordinator to run your timeline on the day
Arrival and key moments planned around sunset
Food and drinks not included (add Ocean-to-table catering)

fields.name: Sunset Social
fields.features:
Seaside setup for up to 250 guests
Tables, chairs and lounge-style seating
Sound system, background music and a microphone for speeches
Team on site to welcome guests, serve, assist and clear away
Event coordinator from setup to close
Food and drinks not included (add Ocean-to-table catering)

fields.name: Private Island
fields.features:
Exclusive use of the venue for up to 250 guests, with no other events
Entertainment and production planned with you: live music or DJ, stage and lighting
Dedicated team to welcome guests, serve, assist and clear away
Event coordinator who plans with you beforehand and runs the day
Food and drinks not included (add Ocean-to-table catering)

fields.name: Coastal styling
fields.description: Natural textures, considered florals, candlelight, and tablescapes that belong to the landscape.

fields.name: Photography
fields.description: Thoughtful coverage of the people, atmosphere, and small unscripted moments that make the day yours.

fields.name: Ocean-to-table catering
fields.description: Fresh, generous menus served with an easy rhythm from welcome aperitifs to the last toast.

fields.name: Interactive Experience
fields.description: Captivating fire-art performances, a rustic 'create-your-own' beach favor station, and small-group masterclasses.
